subject: CAIQ control rationale, vendor proofs and runtime trace ask
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratahealth.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sec-ops@stratahealth.com
Date: 2026-12-08T09:12:00Z
Subject: CAIQ follow-up: controls where vendor evidence required

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick call this morning. As discussed, our compliance team needs a CAIQ crosswalk that includes:
- Short rationale for any control you mark as 'Implemented' vs 'Partially Implemented' (2-3 sentences each)
- Proof artifacts for encryption, key management (we need vendor attestations or architecture diagrams), and runtime telemetry (sample trace showing request->response latency and tokenization scrub).
- A list of third-party dependencies with their control boundaries (SSO, KMS, monitoring).

Can you confirm what you can deliver by EOD Friday (2026-12-10)? If some items need more time, please call them out and propose dates.

Also attaching the CAIQ template we use (see attached). If you prefer, send an annotated spreadsheet with links to Drive artifacts.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Senior Security Program Manager | StrataHealth

Attachment: Strata-CAIQ-template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-08T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: controls where vendor evidence required

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can cover the majority of the asks by the deadline; two quick clarifications below and a proposed delivery plan.

Quick clarifications:
1) Runtime trace: do you require redacted token-contents (we will provide sanitized traces with token ids removed) or only timing/route metadata?
2) KMS proof: is a vendor-supplied SOC 2 summary acceptable, or do you need HSM attestation documents?

Proposed delivery (we'll upload to a shared Drive folder and ping you the link):
- 2026-12-10 EOD: CAIQ annotated spreadsheet (control-level rationale) + SOC-2 summaries for third-party SSO and monitoring vendors.
- 2026-12-11 noon: KMS architecture diagram + key custody narrative from Kimberly (owner for keys).
- 2026-12-11 EOD (if requested): sanitized runtime trace snippet showing a representative inference request, KV cache usage, and response timestamps.

Kimberly — can you prepare the key-custody narrative and the architecture diagram? Jordan — please assemble the SOC-2 summaries we have for Auth0 and Datadog and attach a brief boundary note.

If that schedule works for you, we'll proceed. If you absolutely need the sanitized trace by EOD Friday, we can expedite but would like to confirm scrub requirements first.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Security and Compliance | Redwood Inference

Attachment: CAIQ-annotated-template-request.xlsx (placeholder)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-08T13:20:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: controls where vendor evidence required

Thanks Priyom — I'm on it. Short answers and what I'll attach: 

- Runtime trace: we will provide timing + metadata only (no token payloads). I'll include a redaction checklist we used for the sample.
- KMS proof: we have a hardware-backed key policy and an HSM-managed KMS in our Private deployment option (customer-managed KMS uses HSM). For hosted Redwood, keys for platform telemetry are in a cloud KMS (AWS KMS) backed by multi-tenant HSM. We will attach: 
  * kms-architecture-diagram.pdf (shows logical flow and custody boundaries)
  * vendor-soc2-summary.txt (Auth0 SOC 2 excerpt, Datadog SOC 2 excerpt)
  * kms-key-rotation-policy.txt (excerpt)

I will also add a brief control justification file for controls SC-13, SC-12 and CP-9 (two paragraphs each) and indicate where assertions rely on third-party SOC reports.

I will upload to the Drive folder and share the link with the Strata team. Priyom — I'm copying Jordan to pull the vendor summaries.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms-architecture-diagram.pdf (pdf), kms-key-rotation-policy.txt (txt), control-justifications-SC.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: sec-ops@stratahealth.com
Date: 2026-12-09T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: controls where vendor evidence required

Priyom / Kim — thank you, that plan is helpful. A couple follow-ups from our intake team: 

- The runtime trace sanitized for timing/metadata only is fine. Please include a short note that the sample is representative (peak/steady-state) and an approximate request-rate during capture.
- For KMS: the HSM-backed diagram + rotation policy will satisfy the initial ask. Please also enumerate the persons/roles that have key-management authority in your custody narrative (we'll need owner names and role descriptions, not personal PII).
- Can you add a one-page mapping that highlights any controls where your assertion depends on a third-party SOC report (call this out, e.g., "Auth0: SC-7 uses Auth0 SOC 2 for authentication controls").

We have an internal deadline of 2026-12-15 to complete vendor evaluation. If you can get the annotated CAIQ and KMS artifacts into the Drive folder by 2026-12-11 EOD as proposed, we'll be able to close our intake.

I'll keep an eye on the Drive link you send and ping if anything else comes up.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: none (inline request)
